text: If your cat ever knocks on your bedroom door... do not open it.
Do not get up. Do not turn on the light. Do not call out.
It is three twelve in the morning.
This is Instruction zero zero one. Follow every step, in order. There are four steps. You will only be given three.
Step one. Do not open the door.
Listen to where the knock comes from. Not the bottom of the door. The middle.
A cat that wants in will scratch. It will push. It will cry.
It will not knock. Cats do not knock.
This one knocks at the height of your hand.
It has been standing like that for a while. Its legs were not made for it. It does not seem to mind.
Step two. Do not look under the door.
There is a light on in the hallway. You did not leave it on.
In the gap under the door, there are two shadows. Your cat stands on four.
Do not count them again. The number will not change.
Then it will meow.
Grown cats almost never meow at each other. The meow is a sound cats made only for people.
Something outside your door has been studying that sound for a long time.
It is close. But it is too slow. It is too low. And it comes from too high up.
Step three. Look at the foot of your bed.
Your cat is there. It has been there all night.
Then what is knocking?
Do not watch the door anymore. Watch your cat.
Cats hear sounds far higher than you can. Footsteps you will never hear. Breathing you will never hear.
Tonight, your cat is not asleep. It is listening.
If its ears turn to the door, do not move. If its tail gets big, hold your breath.
If it lies down and closes its eyes... it is gone. You can sleep now.
Your cat has done this before. Many nights. You thought it was just sleeping on your feet.
In the morning, your cat will sit by the bedroom door and wait. Open it. That one is safe.
Look at the door before you leave. Near the middle. At the height of your hand.
Three marks. Like paw prints. Too far apart to be paws.
Step four is for the night the knocking comes from inside your room.
Step four has never been written. Nobody who needed it was able to send it back.
Keep your cat on the bed. Keep your door closed. This was Instruction zero zero one.
